# Golden lock changes

Every file in this folder is the canonical result of the engine as it behaved when the lock was taken (migration
M2). A later step may change a golden only by regenerating it with `--update-golden` (or `UPDATE_GOLDEN=1`) and
adding a row here: what changed, why it is intended, and who accepted it. An unexplained change fails the lock.
